comment: Outcome assertions for conformance/physics.json — the ext-physics extension's conformance is what the world does, not what it renders. Run by the reference solver in CI (viewer/test/physics.test.mjs via runOutcomes); any engine may run the same predicates. Assertion kinds: contact [a, b] within within_s; rest {body, near, tolerance}; bounces {body, min} (impacts above 0.5 m/s).
